query: Recommend an HDMI 2.1 switch with 3 inputs that supports 4K 120Hz, with exact model numbers and prices

children.text: Picked over OREI and UGREEN for reliability in home theater testing — no flicker, no handshake dropouts, no silent fall to 4K@60Hz [1].

items.text: **48Gbps** — full HDMI 2.1; 40Gbps units quietly cap you at 4K@60Hz [1][4]
**VRR + ALLM** — needed for PS5 and Xbox Series X at 4K@120Hz [3][4]
**3 inputs** — 2-in-1-out boxes can't take console + PC + streamer [3]
**Certified 48Gbps cables both ends** — or 4K@120Hz drops out [5]
**HDCP 2.3** — keeps Netflix, Disney+ and disc players working [5]
